SwitchedScreen.description: What became of what the addressed pane showed.

oneOf.description: It stays on the pane: the switch went off, or did not move.

Saving came on and it is now the asset's stored settings, which
every tab on the asset wears.

Saving came on, but the asset's stored settings had changed since
the pane last showed them: the pane dropped what it showed and wears
the stored settings; nothing of its screen was stored.

asset.description: The asset whose switch this is: every tab on it shares it.

screen.description: What became of what the addressed pane showed.
